keyframes_css: @keyframes grainMove { 0% { transform: translate(0, 0); } 50% { transform: translate(-3%, 2%); } 100% { transform: translate(2%, -3%); } }
@keyframes cueLine { 0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.45); opacity: 0.35; } 50% { transform: scaleY(1); opacity: 1; } }

@keyframes roomDrift { 0% { transform: scale(1) translate(-2%, -1%) rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: scale(1.08) translate(2%, 2%) rotate(3deg); } 100% { transform: scale(1.04) translate(-1%, 2%) rotate(-2deg); } }
